reasoning: Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby mission building on Artemis I's success. While there were heat shield concerns from Artemis I, NASA has addressed these issues and delayed the mission accordingly. Historical crewed spaceflight fatality rates are low - NASA has had 3 fatal missions (Apollo 1, Challenger, Columbia) out of ~170+ crewed missions. Modern safety protocols are significantly improved. The free-return trajectory provides inherent safety margins. However, deep space missions carry elevated risks compared to LEO operations. Given NASA's track record, extensive testing, and conservative approach to crew safety, a lethal disaster is unlikely but not negligible.
